Frequently Asked Questions

You can filter POIs by tapping the 'Filter' icon next to the search bar on the main Explore screen. This allows you to select specific categories like restaurants, parks, or historical sites.

Yes. When viewing a location's details, tap the 'Bookmark' icon to add it to your Saved list. Saved locations can be accessed even without an active internet connection through the 'Saved' tab.

To create an itinerary, tap the 'Explore' tab, select a location, and choose 'Add to Itinerary'. You can manage your planned routes in the profile section under 'My Trips'.

Blue markers indicate standard points of interest. Green indicates parks or nature reserves. Orange is used for dining, and Purple denotes historical or cultural sites.
